subject.title: Feature Request: Voice Recognition / Speaker Identification for Voice Interface

question: Should OpenClaw add speaker-verification gating to native and realtime voice surfaces now, and should the first design be local-only enrollment, provider diarization, or a plugin/API seam?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the next step sets a security boundary, stores sensitive voice profile data, and may add config/provider surfaces, so automation cannot safely choose the product and security model.

options.title: Design local-first opt-in speaker gating
options.body: Specify local enrollment, storage/deletion, thresholds, warnings, and native/Gateway hooks before any implementation PR.

options.title: Expose provider/plugin diarization seams first
options.body: Keep core behavior unchanged while defining provider capabilities and plugin APIs that can preserve or filter speaker labels.

options.title: Defer as optional voice polish
options.body: Leave current Voice Wake, push-to-talk, and Talk behavior as-is until maintainers sponsor speaker recognition as a product priority.

recommendation.title: Design local-first opt-in speaker gating
recommendation.body: Specify local enrollment, storage/deletion, thresholds, warnings, and native/Gateway hooks before any implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the native macOS voice paths and Talk handoff surfaces that this design would change first.
